Two upgraded to money-backed lines on the origination ladder (1082792 HOTU vs The Huns -> 87.0%/13.0% HOTU on Polymarket event 1241313 via The Huns Esports -> The Huns; 1093218 Nuclear TigeRES vs UNiTY -> 58.3%/41.7% Nuclear TigeRES via Thunderpick 1.58/2.20 + Bovada 1.606061/2.25 consensus), seven resolved via exact-name five-player Valve Regional Standings rows, and 1081159 resolved via the anchored bo3.gg series-results model (39.0%/61.0% ex-6666).
items.handling: All 9 featured money-line picks (6 Polymarket: 1082858, 1082860, 1082897, 1082898, 1082900, 1082901; 3 Thunderpick: 1082859, 1079202, 1079203) are preserved unchanged by resolve_match(), and all 10 non-featured fixtures carry verified origination picks with explicit method labels and limitations.

items.area: Provider start-time shifts and alias-scope boundaries on NODWIN Clutch Series #13
items.finding: Two provider-side irregularities on NODWIN Clutch Series #13 were identified and documented on Flagged for Review: (1) Polymarket events 1255013 (Metizport vs Brute, 12:00Z), 1252124 (Nuclear TigeRES vs UNiTY esports, 15:00Z) and 1252125 (FOKUS vs ex-Zero Tenacity, 18:00Z) publish start times shifted 3-6 hours from Hotspawn and HLTV (2399117 at 12:00Z, 2399118 at 15:00Z, 2399119 at 18:00Z); the pipeline's strict start-time gate rejects those shifted Polymarket markets and instead resolves all three from exact-time prematch esportsbook lines (Thunderpick 1.35/2.90 for 1079202, Thunderpick 1.50/2.40 for 1079203, and Thunderpick + Bovada consensus for 1093218). (2) Polymarket event 1252123 (cs2-nem-inox-2026-10-26, 09:00Z) prices Team Nemesis vs INOX Division at 72.5% / 27.5% (1c spread), agreeing with the published Valve standings pick (Nemesis, 87.7% / 12.3%), while 'Team Nemesis -> Nemesis' in data/origination/aliases.json is currently scoped only to CIS LAN Championship #9 and PGL Bucharest 2027: Closed Qualifier.
items.handling: Both observations are recorded in data/research/c333bb27/flags.json with official links so reviewers can compare the Polymarket, Thunderpick, Bovada, HLTV and Valve observations directly.
